# Real evidence fixtures (fetched 2026-10-25 from tests.reproducible-builds.org, unstable/amd64)

One `*.diffoscope.json.gz` per flagship cluster member. Use them for T07 (digest parser) and T14 (rules). Every file shows the same single cause: the `.TH` date in a man page generated by argparse-manpage differs between build 1 and build 2. Everything else in each file is derived (md5sums, sizes, `.changes` Files line, file lists).

| package_version | leaves with a diff | `.TH` date build1 -> build2 | leaf |
|---|---|---|---|
| autoflake_2.4.0-1 | 2 | 2026-08-24 -> 2026-08-25 | `autoflake.1` |
| autotiling_1.9.3-2 | 3 | 2026-03-11 -> 2026-03-13 | `autotiling.1` |
| cmake-format_0.6.13-7 | 8 | 2025-08-11 -> 2025-08-12 | `cmake-annotate.1` |
| hatchling_1.32.4-1 | 4 | 2026-10-22 -> 2026-10-24 | `hatchling.1` |
| openqa_5.1790164836.5c04ab047-1 | 2 | 2026-09-23 -> 2026-09-24 | `openqa-label-all.1` |
| osc_1.15.1-1 | 4 | 2025-05-11 -> 2025-05-13 | `osc.1` |
| power-profiles-daemon_0.30-2 | 2 | 2025-11-05 -> 2025-11-06 | `powerprofilesctl.1` |
| psutils_3.3.14-1 | 12 | 2025-09-08 -> 2025-09-09 | `epsffit.1` |
| python-pipx_1.15.0-1 | 4 | 2026-06-30 -> 2026-07-01 | `pipx.1` |
| python-salib_1.6.0-1 | 3 | 2026-09-30 -> 2026-10-01 | `salib.1` |
| python-stone_3.5.5-1 | 2 | 2026-10-06 -> 2026-10-07 | `stone-py.1` |
| svtplay-dl_4.97.1-0.1 | 3 | 2024-08-03 -> 2024-08-04 | `svtplay-dl.1` |
| telegram-send_0.39.2-1 | 4 | 2026-02-02 -> 2026-02-03 | `telegram-send.1` |
| virtme-ng_1.41-1 | 4 | 2026-07-22 -> 2026-07-23 | `vng.1` |

Notes:
- `psutils` and `cmake-format` are the noisy cases: the changed man-page size reorders or changes `file list` leaves, which the digest must mark `derivative`.
- Several pairs are 2 calendar days apart (osc, autotiling, hatchling). The `TZ_SHIFTED_SDE_DATE` detector must allow a gap of up to 2 days (a 26-hour timezone spread can cross two midnights).
- `dbdtxt` (text) output is a box-drawing tree (`│ ├──`), not a unified diff. Prefer the JSON; the text fallback needs its own parser.
